name: The Grounding Hall
reading: Surge's town keeps the power, the relays and the storm gear running (docs/world-building/TOWN_CHARACTER.md gym3_town: deepslate and tuff, weathered and waxed copper). The Relay Works above is the substation where the feeder from his array lands; under it is where the line is earthed: a deep switch hall with the transformer banks along both walls, each bank a stage further up the copper's oxidation ladder, three bus runs hung on chains overhead, lightning rods on every bank, and down the floor a single course of waxed copper that is oxidised at the door and bright by the dais, with a lamp pair set in the floor every third course: the signal line the player walks. The stair is the feeder's own, wound round a copper conduit from the gallery where the cable is terminated. At the far end Surge stands in a control cab four courses up, between two generator housings, in front of a board of redstone lamps whose lit columns rise to a peak over his head. No colonnade, no nave: machinery on both walls, a line in the floor and a board behind him.

The gallery runs 13 long and 4 wide; at its north end the floor opens on the stair's head at (1748, 190, 1407), and the stair winds down four turns (49 treads) to a landing at (1748, 158, 1407) and out of the cable door onto the hall floor at (1748, 159, 1410), 25.3 from Surge: farther than rctmod's forceBattleMaxDistance + 1, so the player is in the hall before he can call the fight.

Surge's Pokemon is 5.5 from the cab's face (cell edge z1433.0 against block centre z1427.5; clear radius 2.93, Raichu's model sweep: 2.57 to spare) and 6.5 from the nearest bank (the cell edge x1742 against x1748.5); the challenger's is 7 behind it, which is the larger of the two Pokemon being 1.5 wide at most (Vikavolt) with the whole of Raichu's 2.93 sweep as well; the challenger stands 3 behind their own. The trainer stand is under the cab top one in front of the seat, so Surge steps to the cab's edge.

challenge_spawner.why: the Challenge spawner the trainers cycle set two north of the gallery seat (data/challenge_mode.json bosses.kanto_ltsurge.spawner.at, moved in this change to (1746, 162, 1435): two west of the seat, flush in the cab's top, redstone under it in the cab, three open cells over it). old_restore is the building's own model at (1747, 190, 1412) and (1747, 189, 1412), measured.

blocks_why: the town's own palette (TOWN_CHARACTER.md gym3_town: deepslate and tuff, weathered and waxed copper) and nothing that is a spawn condition: no grass, leaves, water, sand or carpet. Every copper block is WAXED: an unwaxed one oxidises over time, and the whole point of the gradient is that it stays where it is put. The redstone lamps are lit only with a redstone block touching them (an unpowered lit lamp switches itself off a few ticks after a neighbour changes).
